effects: The Relay's Evening Net: no ground bursts anywhere. The Guard has water at Cornell Road. Bald Peak asks for runners.

net.speaker: The Relay, Evening Net
net.text:
A woman's voice, calm and dry, reading traffic in turn: "This is net control at Bald Peak. No reports of ground bursts anywhere on this net or the ones we relay. Repeat, no ground bursts. The Talbert Guard is running water at the Cornell Road fire station. Hospitals need runners. Next station."

The war doubt lifts a little. Nobody else on the court knows this yet.

done.speaker: The radio
done.text: Static, and then the net again at eight.
